text_block_list.name: Participating Umamusume
text_block_list.text:
Pheeew~~ I'm back! S-So many presents...! 
The reward stage is too crazy... What is 
this happy exhaustion I'm feeling...?

text_block_list.name: Participating Umamusume F
text_block_list.text:
All right, rolled a 2! 
Just 2 more tiles to the goal, almost 
there――

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text: STOOOOOOOP!!

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
Did you think... you're just 2 tiles from 
the goal? 
Tsk-tsk-tsk. Naive, sweeter than peanut 
butter.

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
This here is a Mandatory Stop Point. You 
can't advance without winning this! 
Now then, put on these cute costumes that 
Golshi-chan prepared――

text_block_list.name: Participating Umamusume
text_block_list.text:
Whoa, is that a reindeer costume? There's 
a Santa one too! So cuuute! 
Wait, what is this, like a fashion show??

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
The 'Christmas-1 Grand Prix' is now in 
session~~! 
*Toot-toot honk-honk party horn 
noises*~~~~!!

text_block_list.name: Participating Umamusume
text_block_list.text: C-Christmas-1 Grand Prix~~!?

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
The rules are simple! Perform a short 
Christmas-themed comedy skit!! 
The topic is decided by the roll of the 
dice!!

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
And then! Prove you're funnier than the 
Golshi-chan & Mame-chin duo~~~~!!!!

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text:
Wait, this officer too!?!? 
I have not heard about this!?!?

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
You betcha! I've been telling ya we can't 
start without you! 
When it comes to a comedy partner, 
Mame-chin is the only choice!!

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text:
The judging shall be done by Us. Dance to 
your heart's content.

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
Hmm, hmm... Prop gag with a stick, 
reindeer antlers! 
Over there is a Christmas tree 
impression... Not bad.

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text: Ho, a short skit over there, is it?

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
"When you think of the main dish for 
Christmas dinner... it's tuna!" 
"Why the heck would it be that!" ...I 
sense some seasoned timing there.

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
However!! Standing in your way is 
Gol-Meno!! 
Let's do this, Mame-chiiiin!

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text: Short skit: "Reduced Working Hours."

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text:
A... All right! Delivered the present to 
the good kid in this house.

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text:
Now then, Reindeer-kun, off to the next 
house we GOOOOOOO!?!? 
W-Wait―― Too fast, too fast, too faaast, 
sir, I haven't tied the sack yet!!

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
Cut the crap, our schedule's delayed, 
dammiiiit!! 
Clocking out right on time, full sprint, 
yaaaarggh!! *snort snort snort snort*!!

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text:
I under― I understand, and I'm very sorry, 
but 
the presents are falling ooouuuut!!

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text:
I mean, this is too fast, a violation!! 
This is already at a violating speed, 
sir!! Sto-o-o-o-op――!!

text_block_list.name: Participating Umamusume B
text_block_list.text:
Ahahaha!! Wait a sec, is that even a skit, 
or is she 
just literally dragging her around!? 
Runaway reindeer~~!!

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text:
That gets an 88. 
Everyone, you shall not pass this point 
unless you beat this score.

text_block_list.name: Participating Umamusume E
text_block_list.text:
I'll beat it! Going with an overly 
detailed short impression!! 
'Santa Claus when he finds a single black 
hair in his beard.'

text_block_list.name: Participating Umamusume C
text_block_list.text:
Me too, me too! Um, I'll do Brian-senpai's 
Tibetan sand fox face 
the first time she saw President Rudolf 
dressed as a tree with a sparkling smile!!

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
Bwahaha! You guys got some nice material, 
don'tcha!! 
Bring it on, keep 'em comiiing~~!!

text_block_list.name: Participating Umamusume A
text_block_list.text:
Crazy~~ I never thought I'd end up doing a 
short comedy skit...! 
Feels like I just used up a lifetime's 
worth of humor...!

text_block_list.name: Participating Umamusume B
text_block_list.text:
Your bit was hilarious! By the way, what 
did you do 
at Nakayama-san's spot? She actually 
taught me how to play poker...!

text_block_list.name: Participating Umamusume D
text_block_list.text:
Haaah... The reward stage was truly 
incredible... 
I'm just... my heart is so full... It's 
amazing... Today is just amazing...

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
Pheeew~~ ...Now everyone's reached the 
goal. 
Man oh man, this sense of accomplishment 
is like climbing up to Mount Fuji's 7th 
station~

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, well done. That was a splendid 
comedic performance. 
...Oh? Speaking of which, where is 
Meno-san?

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
Hm? Huh? Now that you mention it, she's 
nowhere to be seen. 
And here I told her I'd let her do the 
final ceremonial clap――

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text: ――Thank you for waiting!!

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text:
It is time for the final event, sir! 
From us Santas to everyone, a delivery of 
Christmas presents!

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
"Us"? 
Hey, wasn't the deal that you were the 
only Santa――

――Hey there, quite a turnout. 
Better late than never, your Santa has 
arrived.

text_block_list.name: Golshi and Co.
text_block_list.text: Huh――
